thread:
maya: Bringing up swan-13b int8 on the prod pool — seeing higher latency and sporadic OOMs in the last 2 canaries. p50 okay, but p95/p99 up a lot (360ms -> ~620ms). OOMs on a few large batch requests. Anyone else hitting this?

jason: Yup, noticed in nightly too. Pattern looks like memory fragmentation + some int8 kernel path holding slabs. Reproducer?

maya: Repro script I'm using: 
```
# simple curl to the local serving endpoint
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"model":"swan-13b-int8","prompt":"summarize...","max_new_tokens":1024,"batch_size":4}'
```
OOMs happen when batch_size >= 4 and client max_new_tokens >= 1024.

priya: Two quick experiments to try: disable_prefetch=true and lower the batch_window_ms from 25 -> 8. Prefetch causes larger KV allocations up-front. Also try async_batch_threshold=12 -> 8.

luis: Another quick mitigation: set model default max_new_tokens to 512 for swan-13b-int8 on the hosted catalog. Long decodes amplify memory churn and push jobs into a different kernel path.

perf-bot: :warning: perf-bot registered regression alert for swan-13b-int8 (p99 latency). Incident ticket INC-4321 created.

jason: Patch idea: 1) reduce async_batch_threshold to 8, 2) enable kv_compaction_on_idle=true (evict small fragments after a short idle), 3) add a request-level size backoff that rejects >2k tokens when concurrency high. I'll open a PR.

maya: Thx — I rolled jason's staging patch to canary (staging-swarm-3). Early numbers: p99 dropped to ~395ms, no OOMs in 1000 requests. Rolling a 10% prod canary now.

priya: Heads up — our eval harness flagged a quality regression after quant change (subtle tokenization mismatch). We need to run the regression suite against the patched runtime + quantized weights before full rollout.

luis: Logging snippet I used to capture allocation stack: 
```
# set env to get allocator traces
RUNTIME_ALLOC_TRACE=1 ./serve --model swan-13b-int8 --bind 0.0.0.0:8080
```
That showed many small KV allocations from prefetch. Turning prefetch off cuts those in half.

maya: OK loop: 1) canary 10% (monitoring dashboards), 2) run eval suite with full prompts and regression tests, 3) if good, flip default max_new_tokens to 512 for int8 variant and add a note in the model catalog. Keeping thread open, will post prod outcome and postmortem. :thumbsup:
